title: SREC Nandyal Conferred UGC Autonomous Status with NAAC 'A+' Re-Accreditation
summary: University Grants Commission (UGC) and JNTUA have extended the autonomous status of Santhiram Engineering College, recognizing high research output and 94% placement record.
content: The UGC expert committee highly commended the institution's state-of-the-art AI labs, Cadence VLSI EDA tools, modern central library, and green solar campus.
author: Office of the Principal

title: B.Tech AP EAPCET 2026 Admissions Counselling Phase-I Commences (Code: SREC)
summary: Eligible candidates are advised to exercise Web Options with college code 'SREC' for B.Tech in CSE, CSM, CSD, ECE, EEE, ME, and Civil branches.
content: Full fee reimbursement (Jagananna Vidya Deevena) is applicable for eligible Andhra Pradesh state rank holders.
author: Admissions Directorate

title: Microsoft & Amazon On-Campus Placement Drive for 2026 Passing Batch Announced
summary: Career Development Cell (CDC) invites eligible final year students for technical coding rounds scheduled from August 28th.
content: Registered students can access mock coding assessments on the CDC portal and SREC CodeTantra LMS platform.
author: Dean Placements & CDC

title: Autonomous End-Semester Examination Timetables Released (R23 / R20 Regulations)
summary: B.Tech, M.Tech, MBA, and MCA regular and supplementary theory examination schedules are now available for student download.
content: Hall tickets will be generated online through the Student Portal beginning 3 days before exam commencement.
author: Controller of Examinations

title: SREC Team Secures 1st Prize in National Level Smart India Hackathon (SIH 2026)
summary: A 6-member student team from CSE & CSM won ₹1,00,000 cash prize for an AI-based healthcare diagnostic platform developed for rural primary health centers.
content: Chairman Dr. M. Santhiramudu and Principal Dr. M. V. Subramanyam felicitated the winners with merit scholarships.
author: R&D Cell
